upload_url.description: The signed upload URL for the client to upload the file

media_url.description: The public URL for the media, to use once file has been uploaded

scheduled_at.description: Scheduled date and time for the post in UTC (ISO 8601), setting to null or undefined will post instantly

media.description: Array of media associated with the post. If multiple media items are provided and the placement is `stories`, individual posts are created per media item.

social_accounts.description: Array of social account IDs for posting

external_id.description: Array of social account IDs for posting

isDraft.description: If isDraft is set then the post will not be processed

thumbnail_url.description: Public URL of the thumbnail for the media

thumbnail_timestamp_ms.description: Timestamp in milliseconds of frame to use as thumbnail for the media

alt_text.description: Alt text describing the media, passed to platforms that support it

tags.description: List of tags to attach to the media

skip_processing.description: If true the media will not be processed at all and instead be posted as is, this may increase chance of post failure if media does not meet platform's requirements. Best used for larger files.

index.description: Explicit sort position of this media item within the post (or within its platform/account override). If omitted, the item is ordered by its position in the submitted array.

external_id.description: Provided unique identifier of the post

status.description: Current status of the post: draft, processed, scheduled, or processing

scheduled_at.description: Scheduled date and time for the post in UTC (ISO 8601)

media.description: Array of media associated with the post

social_accounts.description: Array of social account IDs for posting

created_at.description: Timestamp when the post was created, in UTC (ISO 8601)

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the post was last updated, in UTC (ISO 8601)

id.description: The unique identifier of the social account

platform.description: The platform of the social account

username.description: The platform's username of the social account

user_id.description: The platform's id of the social account

profile_photo_url.description: The platform's profile photo of the social account

access_token.description: The access token of the social account

refresh_token.description: The refresh token of the social account

access_token_expires_at.description: The access token expiration date of the social account, in UTC (ISO 8601)

refresh_token_expires_at.description: The refresh token expiration date of the social account, in UTC (ISO 8601)

external_id.description: The external id of the social account

metadata.description: The metadata of the social account

id.description: The unique identifier of the post result

social_account_id.description: The ID of the associated social account

post_id.description: The ID of the associated post

success.description: Indicates if the post was successful

error.description: Error message if the post failed

media.description: Array of media URLs associated with the post

privacy_status.description: Sets the privacy status for TikTok (public, private, followers, friends)

is_ai_generated.description: Flag content as AI generated on TikTok

is_draft.description: Will create a draft upload to TikTok, posting will need to be completed from within the app

auto_add_music.description: Will automatically add music to photo posts

title.description: Overrides the `title` from the post (maps to snippet.title)

description.description: Description for the YouTube video (maps to snippet.description). Falls back to the post caption when not provided. Maximum 5,000 bytes (UTF-8); longer values are truncated.

category_id.description: YouTube video category id (maps to snippet.categoryId; see YouTube Data API videoCategories.list)

default_language.description: Default language of the video (BCP-47 language tag, e.g. "en"). Maps to snippet.defaultLanguage.

localizations.description: Per-language localizations for the video title and description. Keys are BCP-47 language tags (e.g. "fr", "es"). Maps to localizations on the YouTube Data API videos resource.

privacy_status.description: Sets the privacy status of the video (maps to status.privacyStatus), will default to public

embeddable.description: If true the video can be embedded on other websites (maps to status.embeddable). Defaults to true.

license.description: The video's license (maps to status.license). "youtube" is the standard YouTube license; "creativeCommon" is Creative Commons.

public_stats_viewable.description: If true, the extended video statistics are publicly viewable (maps to status.publicStatsViewable). Defaults to true.

publish_at.description: ISO 8601 datetime in UTC at which the video should be published. Only honoured when privacy_status is "private" (maps to status.publishAt).

made_for_kids.description: If true will notify YouTube the video is intended for kids (maps to status.selfDeclaredMadeForKids), defaults to false

contains_synthetic_media.description: If true, marks the video as containing altered or synthetic content per YouTube's disclosure policy (maps to status.containsSyntheticMedia). YouTube adds a "How this content was made" label to the description automatically.

has_paid_product_placement.description: Whether the YouTube video contains paid product placement, sponsorships, or endorsements (maps to paidProductPlacementDetails.hasPaidProductPlacement). If omitted, YouTube defaults to false.

recording_date.description: ISO 8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD) or UTC datetime when the video was recorded (maps to recordingDetails.recordingDate).

collaborators.description: Instagram usernames to be tagged as a collaborator

share_to_feed.description: If false video posts will only be shown in the Reels tab

location.description: Page id with a location that you want to tag the image or video with

trial_reel_type.description: Instagram trial reel type, when passed will be created as a trial reel. If manual the trial reel can be manually graduated in the native app. If perfomance the trial reel will be automatically graduated if the trial reel performs well.

audio_name.description: Display name for the audio track on Instagram Reels. Only honored on Reels uploads, and only when the audio is original (Meta silently ignores it on licensed/fingerprinted tracks).

is_ai_generated.description: Flag content as AI generated on Instagram
